free_resources.title: Free 45-Minute Healing Meditation
free_resources.description: A free recorded guided meditation of about 45 minutes, streamed from the page on Harshada's approach to meditation. The page sets it within his view of practice as a personal remedy suited to each person's needs.

flags: The page frames meditation as healing in an emotional and spiritual sense (energy, trauma, clarity); no medical claim.
www.fakiri.org serves no robots.txt (404 page), so nothing is restricted.
